title: Roles
subtitle: A role is a name and a set of permissions. Permissions themselves are frozen in code: a permission nothing reads would be a false promise.
emptyDescription: Roles are seeded when the core starts.

reserved.title: Two things are absent from this matrix
reserved.body: The role-management permission is assignable to nobody, and the {{role}} role cannot be edited. That is what makes "reserved to me alone" true by construction rather than by convention.

errors.forbidden: This screen requires the role-management permission.
